title: Checkbox: Colors (daisyUI)
notes:
Checkboxes are used to select or deselect a value.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/checkbox/+page.md
code:
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-primary" />
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-secondary" />
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-accent" />
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-neutral" />

<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-info" />
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-success" />
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-warning" />
<input type="checkbox" checked="checked" class="checkbox checkbox-error" />
